newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Wednesday on what dealers said was a shortage of funds and lack of interest by major institutional players.
They said the index might fall further as most foreign funds and local instituions were sidelined because of their December 31 account closing while individuals were short of cash.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 3.57 points, or 0.25 percent, to end at 1,413.12. Losers led gainers 199 to 41. Turnover rose to 36.73 million shares from 32.07 million in the previous session.
